\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ} (aṣṭaralli)}{ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ (aṣṭaralli)}]{\kn{ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ} (aṣṭaralli) — meanwhile; by then}

\label{lesson:KA-C327-astaralli}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for to kidnap, then the Kannada for a hostage.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ}} — \emph{aṣṭaralli} — \textquotedblleft{}meanwhile; by then\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ನಾನು} \kn{ಬಾಗಿಲು} \kn{ತೆರೆದೆ}. \kn{ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ} \kn{ಕಳ್ಳ} \kn{ಓಡಿಹೋಗಿದ್ದನು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nānu bāgilu terede. aṣṭaralli kaḷḷa ōḍihōgiddanu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I opened the door. By then the thief had run away.
\end{quote}

\kn{ಅಷ್ಟು}, that much, with -\kn{ಅಲ್ಲಿ}, in: \textquotedblleft{}within that much time\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ}} (\emph{aṣṭaralli}) is native Dravidian: \emph{aṣṭu}, \textquotedblleft{}that much\textquotedblright{}, is built on the pointing base \emph{a-}, \textquotedblleft{}that, yonder\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 1), with the ending -\emph{alli}, \textquotedblleft{}in\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{aṣṭaralli}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{aṣṭaralli}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nānu bāgilu terede. aṣṭaralli kaḷḷa ōḍihōgiddanu.} — I opened the door. By then the thief had run away.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for to kidnap, then the Kannada for a hostage, then say \emph{aṣṭaralli} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಅಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Meanwhile; by then\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ} (haṭhāttāgi)}{ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ (haṭhāttāgi)}]{\kn{ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ} (haṭhāttāgi) — all of a sudden}

\label{lesson:KA-C327-hathattagi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a hostage, then the Kannada for meanwhile.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ}} — \emph{haṭhāttāgi} — \textquotedblleft{}all of a sudden\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ} \kn{ದೀಪ} \kn{ಆರಿಹೋಯಿತು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{haṭhāttāgi dīpa ārihōyitu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
All of a sudden the light went out.
\end{quote}

A more bookish partner of \kn{ಇದ್ದಕ್ಕಿದ್ದಂತೆ}. \kn{ಹಠಾತ್} \kn{ಸಾವು} is a sudden death.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ}} (\emph{haṭhāttāgi}) is built on Sanskrit \emph{haṭhāt}, \textquotedblleft{}by force\textquotedblright{}, the ablative of \emph{haṭha}, \textquotedblleft{}violence, force\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), with the Kannada adverb ending -\emph{āgi}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{haṭhāttāgi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{haṭhāttāgi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{haṭhāttāgi dīpa ārihōyitu.} — All of a sudden the light went out.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for a hostage, then the Kannada for meanwhile, then say \emph{haṭhāttāgi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಹಠಾತ್ತಾಗಿ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}All of a sudden\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಕೂಡಲೇ} (kūḍalē)}{ಕೂಡಲೇ (kūḍalē)}]{\kn{ಕೂಡಲೇ} (kūḍalē) — at once; immediately}

\label{lesson:KA-C327-kudale}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for meanwhile, then the Kannada for all of a sudden.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಕೂಡಲೇ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಕೂಡಲೇ}} — \emph{kūḍalē} — \textquotedblleft{}at once; immediately\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಸುದ್ದಿ} \kn{ಕೇಳಿದ} \kn{ಕೂಡಲೇ} \kn{ಅಜ್ಜ} \kn{ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ} \kn{ಹೊರಟರು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{suddi kēḷida kūḍalē ajja āspatrege horaṭaru.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
As soon as he heard the news, Grandfather set off for the hospital.
\end{quote}

After a past form it means \textquotedblleft{}as soon as\textquotedblright{}: \kn{ಕೇಳಿದ} \kn{ಕೂಡಲೇ}, as soon as (he) heard.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಕೂಡಲೇ}} (\emph{kūḍalē}) is built on the native Dravidian verb \emph{kūḍu}, \textquotedblleft{}to join, to meet\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 1882), with the emphatic ending -\emph{ē}; how it came to mean \textquotedblleft{}at once\textquotedblright{} is not settled.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kūḍalē}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kūḍalē}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{suddi kēḷida kūḍalē ajja āspatrege horaṭaru.} — As soon as he heard the news, Grandfather set off for the hospital.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for meanwhile, then the Kannada for all of a sudden, then say \emph{kūḍalē} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಏಕಾಏಕಿ} (ēkāēki)}{ಏಕಾಏಕಿ (ēkāēki)}]{\kn{ಏಕಾಏಕಿ} (ēkāēki) — abruptly; all at once}

\label{lesson:KA-C327-ekaeki}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for all of a sudden, then the Kannada for at once.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಏಕಾಏಕಿ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಏಕಾಏಕಿ}} — \emph{ēkāēki} — \textquotedblleft{}abruptly; all at once\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಏಕಾಏಕಿ} \kn{ಬಸ್} \kn{ನಿಂತಿತು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ēkāēki bas nintitu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
All at once the bus stopped.
\end{quote}

Of something sudden and without warning: \kn{ಏಕಾಏಕಿ} \kn{ನಿರ್ಧಾರ}, an abrupt decision.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಏಕಾಏಕಿ}} (\emph{ēkāēki}) is usually traced to Hindustani \emph{ekāek}, \textquotedblleft{}suddenly, all at once\textquotedblright{}; its earlier history is not settled.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ēkāēki}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ēkāēki}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ēkāēki bas nintitu.} — All at once the bus stopped.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for all of a sudden, then the Kannada for at once, then say \emph{ēkāēki} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳು} (beccibīḷu)}{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳು (beccibīḷu)}]{\kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳು} (beccibīḷu) — to be startled}

\label{lesson:KA-C327-beccibilu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for at once, then the Kannada for abruptly.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳು}}
\textbf{\kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳು}} — \emph{beccibīḷu} — \textquotedblleft{}to be startled\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಗುಡುಗು} \kn{ಕೇಳಿ} \kn{ನಾನು} \kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬಿದ್ದೆ}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{guḍugu kēḷi nānu beccibidde.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I was startled when I heard the thunder.
\end{quote}

Past (I …): \kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬಿದ್ದೆ}, \emph{beccibidde}.

\kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿ}, startled, and \kn{ಬೀಳು}, to fall: to jump with fright. The past is \kn{ಬಿದ್ದೆ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳು}} (\emph{beccibīḷu}) is a native Dravidian compound: \emph{beccu}, \textquotedblleft{}to be startled, alarmed\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 5489), and \emph{bīḷ}, \textquotedblleft{}to fall\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 5430).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{beccibīḷu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{beccibīḷu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{guḍugu kēḷi nānu beccibidde.} — I was startled when I heard the thunder.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for at once, then the Kannada for abruptly, then say \emph{beccibīḷu} again
\end{itemize}
